name: Belgium
shortSummary: Belgium's relationship with India is anchored by the Antwerp-Surat diamond trade pipeline and its role as a diplomatic gateway to the European Union institutions headquartered in Brussels.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: The Antwerp-Surat pipeline handles a large share of the world's rough and polished diamond trade.
Belgium hosts institutions central to India's broader EU engagement, including free trade agreement talks.

recentDevelopments.title: Diamond trade and EU-gateway engagement continue
recentDevelopments.description: The Antwerp-Surat diamond pipeline and Belgium's role in broader India-EU engagement continued steadily.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A stable, low-friction relationship anchored in commercial ties and EU institutional access.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India and Belgium establish diplomatic relations shortly after Indian independence.

trade.majorExports: Cut and polished diamonds, textiles, chemicals

multilateralRelations.detail: Brussels serves as the seat of EU institutions, making Belgium a key node for India-EU engagement.
